PDF Volume illustration: nonphotorealistic rendering of volume models ...
The volume illustration approach combines the benefits of the two traditional volume rendering approaches in a flexible and parameterized manner. It provides the ease of interpretation resulting from familiar physics-based illumi-nation and accumulation processes with the flexibility of the transfer function approach.
